notes.title: Final Version and features
notes.notes:
The Cenozoic Era - Final Version Update & Exciting New Features!

Hello Cenozoic Era community!

The final version of The Cenozoic Era, We’ve been working hard to bring you a truly immersive experience, with plenty of features and gameplay. This update brings the final version of the game to a close and what to expect on release.

Release is planned to come out around the 10th-15th of February

The Animal Hub: A New Showcase for Your Rare Creatures
We’re renaming the Marketplace to the Animal Hub, and it’s going to be your go-to destination for everything related to highly bred, rare animals! In addition to showcasing these creatures, you’ll now have the ability to transfer animals to different servers or even move them to the Event Server, we've decided to remove the sell option for animals.

The Event Server will allow you to battle your animals without the risk of permanent loss. Anyone can connect to the Event Server, and spectators will have a special camera to watch the action unfold. And if your animal wins, you’ll have a chance to earn free DLCs as rewards. There’s no better way to show off your breeding skills and fight for some epic prizes!

Play Style Choice: Tailor Your Experience
To ensure everyone can find a server that suits their preferences, we’ve set in place the Play Style Choice feature. Now you can select servers based on your preferred style of gameplay, whether that’s pure realism or something a bit more flexible with skin creation. Servers will be able to fine-tune settings to match any play style you want, making your experience unique and customizable.

Dynamic Seasons
Experience the full dynamic season system, where every in-game year brings new challenges & opportunities, this feature is designed to bring more challenge to your gameplay and immerse yourself in a ever changing landscape, from food source impacts and adaptions, to freezing to death, this system will challenge your abilities to survive.

Breeding and mutations
This system is designed to enhance your gameplay and forge the best of the best animal stats. If a animal is a newborn and was mutated you will see the mutation put into random stats, however, you wont know the animals full mutation until it reaches about 75% in growth size.

As well as breeding mutations we also have a new challenge aimed at breeding, animals can have a chance to birth several babies at a time and on the same note can also suffer loss of a baby before it is born, resulting in a failed pregnancy. During birth your animal has a possibility of death during delivery (This feature is only for realism servers)

Two Maps, Bigger and Better Gameplay
We’re adding two maps to the game:

- North American Themed Map: A vast, expansive environment filled with large mountains and vast valleys with plenty of opportunities for adventure.
- North American Island Map: A smaller, more compact version designed for lower-end PC support and close-quarters gameplay.

These two maps will cater to different playstyles, ensuring that everyone can enjoy The Cenozoic Era no matter their hardware or preference.

Coin System & Community Servers
As we've talked about before, the Integrated Coin System designed specifically for community servers. The Coin System will allow players to earn free growths without needing admin intervention, making the experience more accessible for everyone. But, please note that animals grown using this system will not be eligible for upload to the Animal Hub, and sandbox animals or animals with grow commands also won’t be uploadable.

Animal deaths
For those wondering about animal death, keep in mind that any animal that dies (for any reason) will have that death permanently recorded in the save file. You’ll be able to see how many times it’s died when browsing the Animal Hub. Additionally, you can see how many events it won as well. Animals that have died will not be allowed to participate in any events so please use caution before playing in any server with your rare animal. (The event server is excluded from this, if an animal dies during an event it does not count against it)

Can I recover my animal if I was banned?
Yes, you can log into a server you were banned from and export your animal to the animal hub. But you will be kicked if you try to play while banned. You can also export a dead animal to the hub and put in a claim for recovery (This is put in place in case a admin or server owner decides to slay your animal for no reason, or if, you lost your animal and cant get in contact with a server owner to have it recovered) we recommend to always export your animal to the hub atleast once, this ensures there is a backup of it stored on our servers so it can be restored if it meets eligibility.  

Admin Commands: More Tools for Your Servers
We’ve also added a bunch of new admin commands to make managing servers more fun and interactive. One of the standout features is the Jailed Command – yes, your animals can now be jailed for a certain amount of time in an actual jail cell! This new mechanic is a fun alternative to the regular kick and adds a little more spice to managing unruly players, players who love to troll will also love this, its just fun.

Additionally, we’ve added a server rules board where your jailed animal can easily view all the server rules, and now jailed creatures will be required to accept an onscreen message confirming that they’ve read and understood them before they can be released.

All of your staff members, their colors and permissions can be adjusted within the command panel (Only accessible by staff with the server management permission/owner) You can also use the new role system for dedicated players on your server, this system currently has Supporter and Vip role, but we plan to expand it later on. Both of those new roles can be colored as well. The best part of this system is it allows server owners or server managers the ability to remove and add staff without having to run a server restart, same for any role color changes.

We've also added a tag system, next to a players username as a rank assigned to them (Owner, Senior Admin, Admin, Moderator, Vip & Supporter) Tag will look as such: [Admin] Username

Special Offer from Bisect Hosting!
To help kick off these exciting new updates, Bisect Hosting is offering a 25% off coupon code for new servers. If you’ve been thinking about starting your own server, now is the perfect time!

---

We can’t thank you all enough for your support during development. Your feedback and dedication have helped shape The Cenozoic Era into the game it is today, and we can’t wait for you to dive into this final version. Whether you're breeding the rarest animals, competing in epic battles, or just exploring the vast landscapes, there’s so much to discover.

Enjoy the update, and we’ll see you in The Cenozoic Era!

— The Development Team 🌿

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/66e6260eaa15e946fcb21096ca9cd17088b5ab16.png
Hello, It's been a good while.

So lets start with where everything has been over this last month, the game recently went into Q/A for play testing and the majority of the bugs have been ironed out and fixed preparing us for a very soon public beta release. September 1st looks like a solid date for the official release, if other issues arise it could be pushed back a couple days, but it will be very soon.

So I want to list all features that will be with the recode on its release:



Pregnancy
A highly requested feature that is now coded into the game, the mother will slowly appear pregnant (Physically) and a new UI Icon will appear to show how far along the pregnancy is until birth, It takes 15 minutes until ready to give birth to allow a fair bit of time for a cooldown so babies aren't spammed.


Grouping
There's a reason I've included this because Grouping has had a overhaul to how it works, there will be a new UI that will appear once you have 2+ members in group that will display on the HUD showing how many members are in group, their usernames and what gender they are. With this they will also appear on your map as orange arrows to show where they are in the map to make locating them easier. And if a member dies/leaves group a UI prompt will display making the members aware that they have left the group. 


Growth
We've talked about this before, but your character will start from 1/4 its size and slowly grow into adult without the whole character popping effect from the past version.


Charging attacks
I've posted a video about this, but attacks are chargeable up to 2x its normal power, they take about 5 seconds to fully charge up while holding left click, if the charged attack is above 1.5x a camera shake effect will be applied once the attack button is released.


Survival and Sandbox
Two gamemodes as usual, a survival and sandbox gamemode


Map & Minimap
We've talked about these before, but the game will have both a mini map and main map, the main map is where you can find other members of your group


Quests
Your character will be provided random quests that can impact its mood, later down the road this will expand into its overall stats, but before we add this feature to that extent we want to test out the questing system to make sure its not to overwhelming or kills the overall gameplay for some players, so depending on how it goes will depend on how far into the questing system we expand, however, it will not affect nothing more than the characters mood on the initial release, so it can be written off as optional at this point. 


Sniffing
I've posted videos of the sniffing mechanic, the longer you sniff the longer your range becomes unlike the old one with all new updated icons


Playables
Cougar and Elk are going to be the only two playables, the biggest reason for this choice is to make sure we have both a solid carnivore and a solid herbivore, the game was coded extremely well for adding new creatures so once everything is ironed out expect new playables to slowly roll in, the reason I've opted to keep this all very slow is to ensure each animal is tuned correctly and is unique in its own way. 



Keep this in mind this game was rebuilt from the ground up in a whole new project, it has a brand new foundation so other features that are planned can take some time to roll in, but be patient as everything is coming, I predict by Feb. 2024 or December of this year the recode should be completely finished, i hope to see you all for the journey

Hello, everyone

In this recode we're going to go over a couple things, share an idea for the a diet/questing system but first lets start with the UI and some changes that were made

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/7128ff6fe314910e5fa19dd7d07e433dc6498fc0.png

There's been a few changes made here, it will show your current growth size, stored fat & body temperature, yes the temperature returns for the recode, a bit of time was spent on getting this UI fully working and tested properly. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/a40aa0eaf029c2c2ff5013771bf0014f9e7c415c.png

Another new small feature that was needed was an option to mute other players in chat, we know, people can be nasty or ruin your time playing with their sarcastic remarks, we got you covered in the recode



Now lets talk about the growth system, you can find a timelapse video below
[previewyoutube=npPRE7Tieqc;full][/previewyoutube]

The character will start off at 10% of it's full adult size and will seamlessly grow until it's fully grown, this system works perfect and will be a great introduction, it can also support any model used, so it's a very solid system that can be easily expanded upon 

Idea

So now I want to share some of my thoughts on a new Quest/Diet system, I like simple game play and nothing that feels forced, so I combined the Questing with a Diet, so how this works is your animal will want certain things, so lets say you're the Cougar, your Cougars diet will say "Wanting to eat a fish" or "Wanting to eat Prime Meat" what is prime meat? Prime meat is the type of animal thats killed, and it must be a herbivore, Animals like a Moose, Elk etc. will supply you with Prime meat and animals like a Boar, Mule Deer etc. will not, that's just standard meat, Your animal will also have negative side effects for eating other carnivores, which over time can lead to death, so the diet system will follow a quest like system, although its not required it can change how your animals mood feels, with that there will be a semi quest system, so the quest system will say something like "Wanting to explore" so you need to walk around the map a little bit and allow your animal to explore a little bit, otherwise it can impact its overall mood, other things such as "Wanting to swim" these little things you can do for your animal to improve its mood will fill the gaps when gameplay is a tad stale or not much to do

Baby animals will have different types of quests, things that match babies, such as "Wanting to run" or "wanting to jump" or "wanting to be near my mother" etc. theres a lot that can be done with this system to enhance your gameplay, these are just examples, but I will have a full indepth list for each animal to ensure its unique to certain animals as possible, such as bears, they like berries/fish where as cougars like just the fish

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/66e6260eaa15e946fcb21096ca9cd17088b5ab16.png
Hello everyone,

In this progress update I want to first talk about the networking route that has been taken, the game will feature Epic Online Services as it's main way to connect players, there's many benefits to this choice, such as cross platform, secure servers & Anti-Cheat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/280b15712749c51d4a91f2c319d441f646755c4a.png

At this point in time I am not sure if account linking will be enabled or not, There's a few benefits to account linking that makes the backend a little easier to use, however it can also just use your Steam account as a login with no linking and you'll play as normal like if EOS wasn't apart of the game.

However, EOS is here to stay and will be the new way to connect players.


Combat

So a little bit about combat and what's been done with this, The combat system is more in depth in terms of hit locations and bleed, locations like the head will do more damage, areas like the rear end or legs will do less damage, this also changes how bleed will work, bleed is based on chance, not every hit will cause bleed, but aiming for vital areas like the throat can increase your chances of making the other player bleed by 30% this adds more strategy and realism to the combat system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/e43913c35a0a56d73c47b9ca8ae6944d7227d770.png

Each blood patch you see on the cougars neck and face is a bite location, instead of scars or other means of showing damage we've opted to use true hit locations which could possibly heal into scars and reflect your characters fights and struggles. 


Some more of the week will be spent on setting up EOS fully and logging into development servers and streamlining the whole thing to make it as easy as possible to connect and play. 

During this week I've done the combat, EOS and setting up the player stats such as health, thirst & hunger, which all three of those are in place and fully working, along with the bleed system. Did some work

Hello once again, Survivors
Kept you waiting?

Let's talk about the most anticipated creature, the Sarcosuchus. Did the Sarco live in the Cenozoic Era? No, he did not, we are aware of this, his main purpose is to feel exotic and fill the Gator gameplay for our Gator lovers.

But he's not the only one, the Rhino is another new large herbivore for players to use, This helps contrast the strength of the Sarco with the Rhino

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/e5b22b7a5c698689a475f57040a5dbac2558f9aa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Map Changes

As many of you know, we redid the environment to not only look more realistic but feel more exotic and primordial, we did keep a backup of the original Hateg Isle incase certain players cant run the new map, to use the old version of the map set the map to "Hateg Isle LQ" and it will use the old version of it, we also brought back Elira as a usable map, although its not officially supported so things could be missing or broke, we may do some TLC work to it sometime in the future

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/6a4e78bfa801b6e1b853a322aefa5ce066cf3245.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/660f44d3b709d39680c228b561e6d5363a1a7aad.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Grab System

Something that was in need of work was the Grab system, the old one was not a very reliable system so we rebuilt it from the ground up to be very reliable and robust, something we showcased was the items floating in water, this no longer the case since it was causing some issues (mainly the Sarco) So expect no more issues from the grabbing system.

This new grab system will allows Sarcos to grab players and kill them, this grab system uses weight, so for instance, Sarcos cannot pickup Rhinos, the only time they can is when they're in the young phase or young adults, otherwise they are not able to be picked up once fully grown, the same applies to the Sarco itself, so if it's a young adult, it cannot pickup a young adult Rhino. this same system applies to all animals for certain weight groups (Such as, fox cannot pick up a elk calf)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Crafting Beds

A new system we added was how beds are created, no longer will you be able to just press B and place a bed, you will need to gather bedding materials to essentially craft one. You can locate bedding materials with the smell key, they will be labeled with a Stick pile icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Boar Changes

We made a much needed change to the Boar, he is now a Omnivore, he can fish, eat meat and plants now

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Animal removal & Horse update

We mentioned the idea of removing Black Bear and Cougar, we took in the feedback to this change and instead we are leaving the Cougar in but removing the Black Bear and Red Deer. These creatures serve no fundamental purpose to being playable as they offer almost nothing for growing one, If we get some new mechanics in such as berry gathering, then the black bear may return for that update.

We brought back the Horse as a playable creature, fixed his ragdoll system, he should be good to go, but keep in mind if issues rearise with the horse again, it may have to be removed, so keep that in mind before you decide to grow one. The model just has issues that are difficult to fix. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Resizing

We also adjusted the animal sizes to be more realistic, ever since I was roasted in the comment section about the Leopard and Cougar I decided to redo their sizes more accurately and readjusted some stats.

We also adjusted the speeds of certain creatures, such as the Big Horned Sheep. Since they were way to slow to be considered as a survivable creature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Weather & Temperature

We spoke about the Temperature system being removed, we heard plenty of feedback on that idea and we decided to leave it in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Bugs

We also patched up some issues and bugs like the sliding bug and the eating while walking bug and some other issues with the camera and skins, I sometimes leave certain bugs out because they haven't had enough testing to conclude it's fixed since it's not a consistent enough issue and difficult to replicate in the editor reliably.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Chat

We also changed chat, you can now switch between chat channels using /local /global /group

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/1c796f8c39eb9d850e3b917a9c5180caa815a838.png

That is it for this update, we hope you enjoy! Cheers!



-Opendix

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/40e3a11ee2286d9e9014807db0f5b46a123e9ba2.png

Hello, Survivors

If you haven't been following along in the discord I'd like to fill you in on where we are with the upcoming update and new things to expect. 

Video Trailer
[previewyoutube=IlyxtvsMHsc;full][/previewyoutube]

We're currently overhauling the graphical aspect of the game, but what does this mean if you can't run this new update? Well, we have a backup of Hateg Isle with it untouched which will be usable in game incase you can't run the new version of Hateg. Region1 has also been left untouched as well. So don't worry too much about the graphical aspect and if your PC can or cannot handle it, we've thought of you

Animal Additions
Yes, it is a Sarco you are seeing, we also do understand a Sarco did not live within the Cenozoic Era, but in the meantime until we have new gator models, this is what we'll be using, along with that we have the Rhino and Zebra coming into the game to help balance out the Sarco with a large Herbivore, The zebra addition is for those who lost the horse during the release of the game.

After some decision making, we've decided to pull out the Cougar and Black bear in this update, the reason being is we don't think they make much sense to be left in as they are nothing unique in terms of playable carnivores and offer almost nothing in return for growing them, the Grizzly and Leopard fill them in as something more powerful and that make more sense, we don't need two versions of a Bear and we don't need two versions of basically a smaller and weaker Leopard

Grab System Rework
We've reworked the full grab system with physics based grabbing, so all pickupable's are physics actors that can be pushed around, float in water, etc. This system will be the most robust system in the game, you can find a video preview of it below with it in action picking up sticks to build beds, yes you will need to gather material now to construct a bed instead of just tapping a button and placing one down

[previewyoutube=8QJ1my15Ip0;full][/previewyoutube]

Seasons
We've thought about this one and we've decided to remove the Seasons system, we find that most servers skip the winter season anyways and it also has been having performance issues as well with the snow, so we've elected to just remove it for now until a better solution comes about.

As you've seen in the Trailer above there was a short clip at the end of a Tornado. Tornados are a planned natural disaster to come, not sure at this time if tornados will be added right away for this update or will come in at a later time.

New animal sounds
We currently have someone creating all new custom sounds for the Animals, these sounds should be added in for this upcoming update, but it's not clear at this time when they will be finalized for the game, but expect them soon. We should also be looking into a modeler pretty soon to get some fresh models in as well

Engine Update
We've also updated our engine from 5.0.3 to 5.1.1, We've taken full advantage of Nanite foliage for the new Hateg, we probably won't be using Nanite on the old Hateg since Nanite requires Directx12 which not everyone has, so we'd like to leave the old Hateg without Nanite to not leave our Directx11 users out of the dark.

Character Selection Preview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/be223c2e85de3d466d3636a699ecc6358bd4aab4.png

For the upcoming update we changed the animal selection preview to fit larger size animals, the old scene had a couple issues with night time previewing, this scene will always be consistent for previewing characters. We also narrowed down the camera bug in the preview screen so that bug will also be fixed, we finally found a consistent method to replicating the problem over and over and we were able to fix that

Conclusion
This concludes the upcoming update, we have more stuff to come as well, we hope you'll enjoy the update! if you want to stay full up to date on news/progress to this update please join our Discord

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/40e3a11ee2286d9e9014807db0f5b46a123e9ba2.png

Hello, survivors

This updates main focus is on performance gains, we've ran lots of testing and here's the results


Performance

The issue we located was the amount of players causing a FPS drop, this wasnt due to the map size or foliage used, this was mostly the players, we ran a test of 100 simulated players and the FPS was sitting around 15, 20 at best. After extensive profiling we figured out what the problem was and resolved it, the problem didnt just affect players, but the surrounding environment. After hours of optimizing we brought the FPS up to a easy 50-60 while simulating 100 players, keep in mind when you're testing in the editor the FPS will be be lower than a built version, theres a few reasons why, I wont go into detail as it's not important, however it's not likely that you will be running 100 players all at once, and if you were the FPS should stick around 60+ but on average you will have about 20 players simulating at most. The issue never was graphical, so thats why even if you lowered your settings nothing changed, it was all in the CPU and theres only so much the CPU can do before it maxes out (Even if task manager isnt showing it, it was) I don't want to get all technical on what's doing it, but the problem should be solved for performance drop and hitching, this might come off as odd, but a larger map should be more performant than a smaller one since on average you will render 0-5 players while playing, where as on region1 you could be rendering as many as 20

Bugs

We've also worked on a few bugs such as a broken spawn point in Region1, we still have a few more to take care of, but for right now we need the performance in check before we take care of the smaller issues that have been reported

Admin Panel overview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/00d3a09321fcb5e3b0b2ece7f14037e8eb7edce8.png

Admin Panel & combat logs

This update also helps with our admins and moderation side as we ditched the old /command method for a admin panel (the panel can be accessed with either the tilde key or 0 key) this will help admins do their tasks of moderation much easier and quicker now. And now that we have a panel that means we can now display combat logs, the combat logs are only accessible by admins of the server, they can search inside the logs and find the player that falsely killed you.

Recent Logouts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/aee2617bb41bb204780d6836178601256ca7bd0f.png

There may be another question you have, what if the player rule breaks and flakes? (breaks the rules and leaves the server) we have a recent logouts panel that you can locate them on, it works the same as the currently online users panel, you can click them and then apply a ban if needed, or if you want, you can delete all their saves from all 4 slots (if needed) 

Banned Players
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/e7a114768744f80bbb5e91c8a5b0da188ce54575.png

We also created the ability to add a reason for their ban, this can also be applied when you can someone, you will see a prompt appear with a text field asking you for the reason, if you don't put one the reason will default to "No reason given" inside the banned users panel you can click the desired player and click "revoke ban" to unban the player

Important
This new ban system dose not use the old method, so current banned users will no longer be banned from servers, you may also see blank slots in there, you can go into your saved games folder (in the server) and delete the "bannedplayers" file, you can delete that and it will clear the blank slots

That is all for now, we hope you have a wonderful day!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/40e3a11ee2286d9e9014807db0f5b46a123e9ba2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png

Hello Survivors,

There has been extensive work done to help push the game forward for content and bug patching, one of our major changes that was done, is the removal of Hyro. Hyro had underlying problems that we are still working to sort out, but for now I welcome you the new map, some of our players here will remember this old map, Elira, Elira underwent a lot of re-work to feature Tropical Swamps and Jungles, Alpine forests and winter forests and even a Desert!

We'd like to share a few screenshots taken from Elira here, but first we'd like to mention that Elira isn't alone in this transformation, Region1 was also revamped to feature the same biomes found in Elira!

Region1 is a smaller map designed for a smaller server, you can play solo in the map and have a enjoyable experience there, if you need extra room then look to use Elira, it's a good size map and can comfortably hold 150 players without being overly large to the point to where you can't locate other players, Both maps can be great options!

The changes made with the maps should also help with your in-game performance and create a overall positive experience, the feeling these maps give off is that of a primordial feeling which we think matches the game extremely well

 Below you can find screenshots taken from both Elira and Region1

Elira
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/471c35c7229a61b52fe320114ad3472240b1f0c5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/8100e1bd095c487ee6cb360cb86dc1c83c43ccf6.png

Now let's talk about bugs and gameplay issues, thanks to everyone's feedback and reports this is what we have done so far.

Rebalancing & Bugs

We've rebalanced some of the animals Speed and Damage, such as cougar, wolf, grizzly bear and some others, we also added their right click attack ability, which can only be used while standing in place, we feel this brings a more realistic approach or else the bite attack becomes useless. We've also fixed the respawn camera bug the purple border being stuck on your screen and the most requested issue, the flashing red border when your player was injured, we adjusted how fast it pulses and reduced the strength so it dosent overwhelm your screen, we adjusted the UI so your chat box will remain overlayed on top of the damage HUD and same for the player stats, weather information panel and tips panel. And of course we fixed the Region1 Issue where players were falling under the map

Servers

One of the biggest challenges we've faced is the disconnection bug, where you keep getting kicked out of the game while attempting to login or while already logged in, we've narrowed down a big issue spotted in code for why this is happening and it has been removed, however we don't have a large enough QA team to test this, but it seems very, very, very likely to have been the cause of the disconnection issues. We've also increased the data limit to our servers to give them a lot more breathing room to send information in and out, if too much information is trying to be replicated and the server isn't given enough head room to preform that task, it will cause the servers pipe line to freeze up and in return you end up with lag or other issues not being replicated correctly, such as bugged skins

Performance

Some stuff in relation to performance was we allowed players to reduce the amount of foliage on screen, thanks to a user on discord who posted a few images showing how this could be used as an exploit. We've since redone this system to prevent users from lowering their settings to see if any predators or afk players are hiding in bushes. And as you can tell all of the foliage has been replaced with new ones, these new trees, bushes etc. are super efficient so everyone should be good to play without problems with performance (keep in mind you do need a somewhat capable machine to play)

Blurry Rendering
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/b8407887ec7e05f8cd67bd6003d78f835049570d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288420/22a600a27c281b2e37f08a2fe6c02ce63588026e.png

Some complaints we had was the game appearing to be blurry, this was due to the rending method we were, the old one we used was FAA which caused a pixelated blur effect, we since switched over to TSR which gives you a nice a crisp look without being pixelated

That is all we have to share about this update, we hope you enjoy the game even more now! If you'd like to help be more involved with development and help us fix locate issues please join our Discord we'd love to have you!

Click here to join our discord


-TheCenozoicEra
